ancestors: DIVISION G—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 425.  Section 426 of division G of 
Public Law 113-76 (16 U.S.C. 565a-1 note) shall be applied by 
substituting ``September 30, 2022'' for ``September 30, 2019''.
